{{Quote|Dried kuvara?''"<br />"''No. Eat up. That's an order.|RC-1136 and Etain Tur-Mukan|<ref name="RC:HC" />}}
'''Kuvara''' was a type of [[Fruit/Legends|fruit]] derived from [[kuvara tree]]s on<ref name="RC:HC" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Qiilura system/Legends|Qiilura system]]</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Qiilura/Legends|Qiilura]]. The fruit was [[Foodstuff/Legends|edible]] plain or dried by [[Human/Legends|Humans]], and the latter form could be [[Stew/Legends|stewed]] with [[merlie]], a creature likewise found on Qiilura.<ref name="RC:HC" />

During a mission to Qiilura by the [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commandos]] of [[Omega Squad]]<ref name="RC:HC" /> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' places the events of ''[[Republic Commando: Hard Contact]]'', which includes the appearance of kuvara, in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Etain Tur-Mukan]] observed that the [[Commando/Legends|commando]] [[Darman Skirata|RC-1136]] seemed to prize a dried kuvara after he offered it to her. Tur-Mukan noted that he kept it in a bag in his [[Belt/Legends|belt]] instead of in his [[Backpack/Legends|pack]] and was touched by the gesture, realizing that since the [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] was usually only issued [[Ration cube/Legends|ration cubes]] he had few opportunities to [[Diet/Legends|eat]] foods such as kuvara, and ordered RC-1136 to eat the kuvara himself. He readily exhibited his enjoyment of the food as he savored it with his [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] closed. Later in the mission, the commandos used dried kuvara in a stew with merlie.<ref name="RC:HC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kuvara appeared in the [[2004]] novel ''[[Republic Commando: Hard Contact|Hard Contact]]'', the first novel in the ''[[Republic Commando]]'' series written by [[Karen Traviss]].<ref name="RC:HC" />
